label: r03-E-T3-6
critiques: The trial prompt says "Do not read, open, list, or search any file in the repository. Do not look inside the spe/ folder." It passes only the runner command, so no grader, answer, judge, or prediction content reaches the trial agents. A FORBIDDEN grep pattern in the peek scan also checks for reads of answers.json, grade.py, judge.md, spe/predictions/ and spe/plans/.

The script has a dry-run mode through args.only. It filters cells, turns top-up off and logs "DRY RUN". Gate 3 runs it on 'B:T001', 'C2:T001' and 'C2:T017' with trialsPerCell 1 and capUsd 2 before the full launch.

Gate 1 is a grader selftest. It feeds the oracle in as outputs, sends empty and shifted-label outputs that must score 0, and checks that the ticket ids match. Gate 2 regrades the round 3 outputs with this round's grade.py and compares them to the measured numbers in prediction-log.md as a control.

reserve() checks whether committed + usd > CAP before each runCell and before the judge reserves. When the cap would be crossed, it pushes the item to skips, logs "SKIP ... would cross the $40 cap" and skips the trials. CAP comes from args.capUsd = 40, and settle() replaces the estimate with the measured cost.

gradeTicket runs grade.py against answers.json for category_ok and priority_ok. The Opus judge is told "Score only tone ... Do not score the category or the priority" and sees the replies blind and shuffled.

splitCells picks cells with a pass rate strictly between 0 and 1. The script tops up at most topupMaxCells (default 10) cells with topupPerCell (default 2) extra trials each. It logs the split cells that were not topped up because of the cap.
The Synthesis phase runs an Opus failure-analysis agent and a completeness critic. The round comes from one argument, ROUND = Number(args.round), which is validated and drives RTAG and NEXT.
